title: Unblocked a team's static-analysis build in an hour
summary: A team found me through the internal Q&A site after a week trying to set up static analysis; an hour of pairing got them their first successful build.
what_would_have_happened: The team would lose more days on setup.
the_call: Pair right away rather than schedule a consultation.
what_i_did: Debugged with them for an hour and suggested changes.
what_changed: They got their first successful build.
